propositions: The pip-audit gating job fails on every patchset against main because click 8.2.1 in uv.lock contains vulnerability PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit).
The vulnerability is unreachable in rebar: click is a transitive dependency only (not imported), and click.edit() is unused in src, tests, or scripts.
inspect-ai caps click below 8.2.2 via its requirement `click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3`, making click 8.2.1 the newest resolvable version under existing constraints.
Remediation: add `[tool.uv] override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"]` to pyproject.toml and relock, allowing click to upgrade to 8.4.2 without removing the inspect-ai [eval] extra.
The override is a workspace resolution directive that does not publish into wheel metadata, so downstream consumers are unaffected; it moves only this repo's locked environments.
